messages:
Jun: heads up from a quick SR audit on the Insights card pagination component. NVDA and VO both behave oddly when jumping pages via the "Go to page" input — SR sometimes reads the newly focused card and then re-reads the previous page header. Maya: thanks. can you repro steps? which control does focus land on after page jump? Jun: steps: open dashboard, focus the page input (e.g., "Page 2"), type 5 and press Enter. the app updates the card list, we set focus to the first card link, but SR reads the page header update and then re-reads the previously focused element. seems like live-region timing vs focus restore race. Priya: markup snippet? curious about any live regions or aria-live usage for pagination counts. Jun: gist: ```
Page 5 of 12
  • Model A
    • ...
``` We update #pagination-live and replace the inner HTML of #cards-list. after update we call `document.getElementById('card-1').focus()` in the callback. Maya: common pattern; the problem is updating live region and subtree at the same time while moving focus. SRs can announce in unpredictable order depending on timing. Nate: two potential fixes: 1) move the live region outside the subtree that gets re-rendered (so its update doesn't retrigger ancestor re-reads), and 2) ensure focus is restored before the live region update (or vice versa depending on what we want announced first). Priya: we should decide UX priority: should SR hear "Page 5 of 12" first or the card title first? my preference: announce the page change first, then focus the first card, so users know context before hearing the card details. However doing that risks the card announcement being suppressed. Alternative: announce page change via a brief live region update, then wait for focus to land and let the SR read the card naturally. Jun: i tried a local variant: update pagination-live, then setTimeout(() => focus card, 50ms). NVDA read the page update first then the card, VO similar. shorter delays sometimes still mixed. Maya: prefer a deterministic approach: 1) keep live region outside of cards subtree, 2) on page change call `updateLiveRegion('Page 5 of 12')`, then in the next animation frame focus the first card (use requestAnimationFrame twice to ensure SR handled live region first). document that behavior in comments. Priya: also ensure we use aria-current="page" on the active pagination button for semantics when using numbered pagination. for the input case, make sure `aria-controls` references the list and we manage `aria-live=off` on the list during updates to avoid duplicate announcements. Nate: another nit: when focusing the first card, prefer using element.focus({preventScroll:true}) after the live region update so we don't cause scroll jumps. keep visible focus ring per focus-visible token. Jun: i'll open a small PR implementing: - move #pagination-live to a stable header container outside cards subtree - call updateLiveRegion first, then use requestAnimationFrame twice before focusing the first card - set aria-current on pagination items and update aria-controls properly - add unit test that simulates page jump and asserts live region text updated before card focus event Maya: add a short e2e that runs the sequence and captures NVDA/VO behavior in CI best-effort; at minimum include the unit test and manual verification note in PR. Priya: small accessibility doc note: "Pagination: place live region outside dynamic list, prefer announcing page changes before focusing items, keep stable ids and aria-current for numbered pagination." Jun: PR #1798 opened, assigned @Jun, reviewers @Maya and @Priya. includes tests and a changelog line: "a11y: deterministic pagination announcements and focus ordering". a11y-bot: created card "Pagination: live region & focus timing" on board `a11y-tasks` with priority `medium`. automated accessibility checks queued for PR #1798. Maya: thanks all. once merged i'll validate on mac+VO and windows+NVDA and report results here. :white_check_mark:
